questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4582209195fc62acf080225b30cc7e9dfd934f0624f9a2af21d01051a6bbfc79.png]
questions.solution:
In this of dice, where two same numbers are placed on two different dice, then the remaining third number on respective dice are opposite to each other.

Here, 3 and 1 are common on both the dice.

So, the remaining number 6 and 2 on both the dice are opposite to each other.

Hence, **6 **is correct.

questions.question: A pipe can fill a leak - proof tank completely in 24 hours. A leakage at the midpoint of same size tank empties half the tank in 36 hours. How much time will it take to fill this tank with the given pipe?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Time taken by inlet pipe to fill a tank = 24 hours 

Time taken by leakage to empty half tank = 36 hours

Time taken by leakage to empty full tank = 72 hours

**Concept used:**

Let capacity of tank is the LCM of time taken by inlet & leakage to fill and empty the whole tank.

**Solution:**

Capacity of tank = LCM of (24, 72)

Capacity of tank = 72 Units

Efficiency of inlet pipe = +72 /24 = + 3 units / hr

Efficiency of outlet (leakage) = -72/72 = -1 Unit/hr

Time taken by inlet pipe & leakage to fill half the tank = 36over (3 - 1) = 18 hrs

Time taken by inlet pipe to fill next half of the tank = 36over 3 = 12 hrs

Total time taken to fill the whole tank = 18 + 12

Total time taken to fill the whole tank = 30 hrs

Hence, **30 hours **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e549cb45ac78aca065082aa5a940b1d6506603cfff2fd1300a22049ad93dc6.png] 

Leak at the middle so the effect of Leak always on the Half Tank. 

The bottom of tank with water is filled without any leakage because leak point is at middle of tank and leakage occurs while filling upper half of the tank only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

If the leak is in the **midpoint of the base of tank**,

The pipe fills 1/24 of the tank in one hour.

The leak empties (1/2)/36 or 1/72 of the tank in 1 hour.

so total water filled in one hour = 1/24 - 1/72 = 2/72 = 1/36.

So the tank gets filled in 36 hours

**Actual Question solution by another method.**

If the leak is in the **midpoint of the wall of tank**,

Pipe takes 1/12 of tank in one hour

Leak empties 1/36 of water in 1 hour

So total water filled in one hour = 1/12 - 1/36 = 1/18

So the second half of the tank gets filled in 18 hours and the first half gets filled in 12 hours.

Total time taken is 12 + 18 = 30 hours

**Note:** Also **30 hours** is the answer given by the Official answer key of CHSL.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All workers are honest.

2. Few of my friends are workers.

3. All my friends are honest.

**Conclusion:**

I. All my friends are workers.

II. All workers are my friends.

III. All my non - worker friends are honest.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only conclusion I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The possible venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/852309fb98f984e66ce97967b033b4b9d0e6ba6c29581706d4e2596ad6ad3271.png] 

For conclusions:

I. All my friends are workers → False (All my friends are workers is a possibility but not definite)

II. All workers are my friends → False (All workers are my friends is a possibility but not definite)

III. All my non - worker friends are honest → True (All the friends, who are not workers are honest)

Hence, **Only conclusion III follow **is correct.

questions.question:
Four numbers have been given below, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number that is different from the rest.

132, 17523, 3164, 2695
questions.solution:
Given series: 132, 17523, 3164, 2695

Except 3164, all other numbers are completely divisible by 11.

1. 132 ÷ 11 = 12

2. 17523 ÷ 11 = 1593

3. 3164 ÷ 11 = **287.63**

4. 2695 ÷ 11 = 245

Hence, **3164 **is correct.

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fa80cffbd4af5d936a8499947446754c190c84a9fff2664cca0fe54983c09a8.png]
questions.solution:
Given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c94906cb511bb2fd1fee045c82dc19ace6e12ea380124b1c6490995607873ff.png] 

**TRICK:**

When a triangle is divided into 2 bases, then we simply number the triangle and add those number.

In triangle IJR: There are two bases i.e. RIB (1) and RJB (2)

So, we'll add these written numbers: 1 + 2 = 3

This means, in triangle RIJ, we have 3 triangles i.e. RIB, RJB and RIJ

Similarly, we have 3 more such triangles i.e. OPQ, LSK and NTM

Therefore, total number of triangles = 3 × 4 = **12 triangles**

Now, when a square is divided into four equal parts, then we simply add those squares and multiply it by 2.

In square QRST, we have four triangles i.e. QUR, RUS, SUT and TUQ

Thus, total number of triangles = 4 × 2 = **8 triangles**

Now, some other triangles i.e. AOJ, PGM, NEK, ICL = **4 triangles**

Thus, total number of triangles = 12 + 8 + 4 = 24 triangles

Hence, **24 **is correct.

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second is related to the first number.

36 : 27 :: 16 : ?
questions.solution:
Given: 36 : 27 :: 16 : ?

36 → (6)² : (3)³ → Second number is cube of the number, which is half of the under root of the first number.

Similarly,

16 → (4)² : (2)³ → Second number is cube of the number, which is half of the under root of the first number.

Hence, **8** is correct.
